entries.jp: 輸送用動物
entries.en: Pack Animal

entries.jp: 輸送兵
entries.en: Transport Soldier

entries.jp: {v:0016}もういないみたいだね。
entries.en: {v:0016}Looks like they're gone.

entries.jp: {v:0017}ああ。{n}それにしても、なぜ輸送隊を襲うんだ？
entries.en: {v:0017}Yeah. But why attack a supply convoy?
{v:0018}I wonder why?

entries.jp: {v:0019}よし。{n}行軍を続けるぞ！
entries.en: {v:0019}All right. Keep marching!

entries.jp: 山頂へ行くんでしょ！？
entries.en: We're going to the summit, aren't we?!

entries.jp: おい、輸送隊がまだ来ていねぇぞ。
entries.en: Hey, the convoy ain't here yet.

entries.jp: 護衛の任務を放って、何処へ行く気だ？
entries.en: Where do you think you're going, abandoning your{n}escort duty?

entries.jp: {v:0008}どうしたの、ティピ？
entries.en: {v:0008}What's wrong, Tippi?

entries.jp: {v:0009}ちょっと、風が強くて‥‥飛ぶのが疲れるぅ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0009}The wind's a little strong... Flying's wearing me ooout...

entries.jp: 何か声をかけますか？
entries.en: Will you say something?

entries.jp: ・気遣う
entries.en: ・Show concern

entries.jp: ・だらしないとあきれる
entries.en: ・Scoff at her lack of stamina

entries.jp: ・自分につかまるように言う
entries.en: ・Tell her to hold on to you

entries.jp: ・無視する
entries.en: ・Ignore her

entries.jp: {v:000A}大丈夫、大丈夫。{n}これくらいで参るティピちゃんじゃないから！
entries.en: {v:000A}I'm fine, I'm fine! It'll take more than this to wear{n}out Tippi-chan!

entries.jp: {v:000B}何ですってぇ！{p}{v:000C}こうなったら意地でも飛んでやるんだから！
entries.en: {v:000B}What did you saaay?!{p}{v:000C}Now I'm going to keep flying if it kills me!

entries.jp: {v:000D}そうね。{n}これ以上、風が強くなったらそうさせてもらうわ。
entries.en: {v:000D}Well, all right. If the wind gets any stronger, I'll take{n}you up on that.

entries.jp: {v:000E}お兄ちゃんにつかまってたら？
entries.en: {v:000E}Why don't you hold on to Big Brother?

entries.jp: {v:000F}大丈夫、大丈夫。{n}これくらいで参るティピちゃんじゃないから！
entries.en: {v:000F}I'm fine, I'm fine! It'll take more than this to wear{n}out Tippi-chan!

entries.jp: {FB00}{v:0010}それにしても、何だかヤな風だな‥‥。
entries.en: {FB00}{v:0010}Still, there's something unsettling about this wind...

entries.jp: {v:0011}まるで山が風を吹かせているみたいだろ？{n}そのせいであの山はシュテーム山と名付けられたんだ。
entries.en: {v:0011}Almost feels like the mountain itself is blowing the wind,{n}doesn't it? That's how Mount Shutem got its name.

entries.jp: {v:0013}隊長！{n}出ました、モンスターです！
entries.en: {v:0013}Captain! Monsters have appeared!

entries.jp: {v:0014}ついに出たか！{p}{v:0015}頼むぞ、君たちの出番だ！
entries.en: {v:0014}So they've finally shown themselves!{p}{v:0015}We're counting on you! You're up!

entries.jp: {FB00}{v:001C}変な匂いのする風だな。
entries.en: {FB00}{v:001C}There's a strange smell on the wind.

entries.jp: {v:0031}ふぅっ。{n}何とか無事のようだな‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0031}Whew. Looks like we made it through in one piece...

entries.jp: {v:0032}しかし、今のモンスターの動きは妙だな。
entries.en: {v:0032}But those monsters were moving strangely.

entries.jp: {v:0033}え、何が妙なの？
entries.en: {v:0033}Huh? What was strange about it?

entries.jp: {v:0034}どこか組織的に動いていたようだが‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0034}Their movements seemed almost coordinated...

entries.jp: {v:0035}そんなわけないよ。
entries.en: {v:0035}No way!

entries.jp: {v:0036}気のせいだといいんだが。
entries.en: {v:0036}Hope I'm just imagining it.

entries.jp: {v:0037}では先を急ぐとしよう。
entries.en: {v:0037}Well then, let's hurry on.

entries.jp: {v:003A}どうも変な匂いのする風だな。{n}この匂いはどこかで‥‥。{n}それとも気のせいか？
entries.en: {v:003A}There's definitely a strange smell on the wind. I've{n}smelled it somewhere before... Or am I imagining it?

entries.jp: {v:002C}出たぞ！{n}モンスターだ！
entries.en: {v:002C}Here they come! Monsters!

entries.jp: {v:002D}出番よ！{n}がんばって！
entries.en: {v:002D}You're up! Give it your best!

entries.jp: {v:003D}ふぅっ。{n}何とか無事のようだな‥‥。
entries.en: {v:003D}Whew. Looks like we made it through in one piece...

entries.jp: {FB00}{v:003E}やっぱりおかしいぞ。{n}奴ら、何かに操られているような‥‥。
entries.en: {FB00}{v:003E}Something's definitely wrong. It's like something's{n}controlling them...

entries.jp: {v:003F}そう言えばそんな感じだった‥‥。
entries.en: {v:003F}Now that you mention it, it did seem that way...

entries.jp: {v:0040}だがどうやってモンスターを操るんだ？{n}それにどこから操っているんだ？
entries.en: {v:0040}But how would anyone control monsters? And where{n}are they doing it from?
{v:0041}Well, you see...

entries.jp: {v:0042}とにかく先を急ぐぞ。{n}前線には我々の到着を待っている兵がいるんだ。
entries.en: {v:0042}At any rate, we must hurry on. There are soldiers on{n}the front lines waiting for us.

entries.jp: {v:0043}ひえぇ！{n}また風だよ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0043}Eeeek! That wind again...

entries.jp: {v:0044}また風か‥‥。{n}そして風に混じるこの匂い‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0044}The wind again... And that smell it's carrying...

entries.jp: {v:003B}くそぉっ！{n}また出やがったぞ！
entries.en: {v:003B}Damn it! Here they come again!

entries.jp: {v:003C}出番よ！{n}がんばって！
entries.en: {v:003C}You're up! Give it your best!

entries.jp: {v:0045}操られているモンスターと、{n}普通の人には感じない匂い？
entries.en: {v:0045}Monsters being controlled, and a smell ordinary people{n}can't detect?

entries.jp: {v:0046}どこかで聞いたような話ね。
entries.en: {v:0046}I feel like I've heard about that somewhere.

entries.jp: {v:0047}いや、間違いない。{n}これはモンスター使いの仕業だ。{p}{v:0048}山から吹き下ろす風に乗せて、{n}モンスターを操る匂いを流してるんだ。
entries.en: {v:0047}No, there's no doubt. This is a monster tamer's work.{p}{v:0048}They're using the wind blowing down from the mountain{n}to carry a scent that controls monsters.

entries.jp: {v:0049}それじゃ敵は山の上に？
entries.en: {v:0049}Then the enemy's up on the mountain?

entries.jp: {v:004A}そいつをやっつければ、もう襲われないんだね？{n}よし、行こうよ！
entries.en: {v:004A}So if we beat them, the attacks will stop, right? All{n}right, let's go!

entries.jp: {v:004B}頼んだぞ！
entries.en: {v:004B}We're counting on you!

entries.jp: まだ敵を倒していないぞ。
entries.en: We haven't defeated the enemy yet.

entries.jp: {v:0071}とにかく、あの傷じゃ、当分まともに動けんだろ。{n}しばらくは輸送隊が襲われることはないな。
entries.en: {v:0071}Anyway, with those wounds, he won't be moving much{n}for a while. The supply convoy should be safe from{n}attacks for now.

entries.jp: {v:0072}それじゃ前線の兵隊さん達も困らなくなるね。
entries.en: {v:0072}Then the soldiers on the front lines won't have to go{n}without supplies anymore.

entries.jp: {v:0073}さて、俺も引き上げるとするか。
entries.en: {v:0073}Well, time I headed out, too.

entries.jp: {v:0074}ちょっと、待ちなさいよ！
entries.en: {v:0074}Hey, hold it right there!

entries.jp: {v:0076}お前は敵か？{n}味方か？
entries.en: {v:0076}Are you an enemy or an ally?

entries.jp: {v:0077}俺の邪魔をするときは敵だが、目的が同じ時は味方だ。
entries.en: {v:0077}Get in my way, and I'm your enemy. Share my goal, and{n}I'm your ally.

entries.jp: {v:0078}どういうこと？
entries.en: {v:0078}What's that supposed to mean?

entries.jp: {v:0079}残念だが、答えられんな。
entries.en: {v:0079}Sorry, but I can't answer that.

entries.jp: {v:007A}それじゃ、あのオズワルドって奴とはどんな関係よ！
entries.en: {v:007A}Then what's your connection to that Oswald guy?!

entries.jp: {v:007B}オズワルドか。{p}{v:007C}奴は俺の弟がやっていた盗賊団の一員だ。{n}弟が死んで、頭になったようだがな。{p}{v:007D}俺とは直接関係ない。{n}たまに仕事をしてもらう程度だ。
entries.en: {v:007B}Oswald, eh?{p}{v:007C}He was in the band of thieves my younger brother{n}led. Seems he took over after my brother died.{p}{v:007D}He's got no direct ties to me. I just give him work now{n}and then.
{v:007E}Work...

entries.jp: {v:007F}ま、アンタらとはまた会うことになるだろうな。
entries.en: {v:007F}Well, I expect we'll meet again.

entries.jp: {v:0080}やつの目的は何なんだ？
entries.en: {v:0080}What's he after?

entries.jp: {v:004C}くっくっくっ！{n}さぁ、私の可愛いモンスター達よ！{n}もう一働きしておくれ！
entries.en: {v:004C}Heh heh heh! Now, my darling monsters! Do one more{n}little job for me!

entries.jp: {v:004D}待ちなさい！
entries.en: {v:004D}Stop right there!

entries.jp: {v:004E}何だ、お前たちは！
entries.en: {v:004E}Who are you?!

entries.jp: {v:004F}お前がモンスターを操って、{n}輸送隊を襲わせていることはわかっている。{n}つまりお前を倒せば、モンスターの襲撃もなくなる。
entries.en: {v:004F}We know you're controlling the monsters and making{n}them attack the supply convoy. That means if we{n}defeat you, the attacks will stop.

entries.jp: {v:0050}ええい、見られたからには生かしてはおけませんね！{p}{v:0051}シャドー・ナイトの私にたてついたことを{n}後悔させてやる！
entries.en: {v:0050}Argh! Now that you've seen me, I can't let you live!{p}{v:0051}I'll make you regret defying a Shadow Knight!

entries.jp: {FB00}{v:0052}シャドー・ナイトだと！？
entries.en: {FB00}{v:0052}A Shadow Knight?!

entries.jp: クエッ？
entries.en: Kweh?

entries.jp: クケッ？
entries.en: Kwek?
...Kuuu...

entries.jp: クエェッ！
entries.en: Kweeeh!

entries.jp: ‥‥ケッ！
entries.en: ...Keh!

entries.jp: 頼んだぞ！
entries.en: We're counting on you!

entries.jp: 少しでも早く、物資を送ってあげないと‥‥。
entries.en: We have to get these supplies to them as soon as{n}we can...

entries.jp: 我々はあまり戦い慣れていないので、{n}早く戻ってきて下さいよ。
entries.en: We're not used to fighting, so please come back quickly.

entries.jp: 我々はあまり戦い慣れていないので、{n}しっかり護衛して下さいよ。
entries.en: We're not used to fighting, so please make sure you{n}protect us.

entries.jp: {FFF6}{v:001A}うわっぷ！{n}{FFF7}また風が強くなってきたね。{n}飛ばされちゃいそうだよ。
entries.en: {FFF6}{v:001A}Waugh! {FFF7}The wind's picking up again! I feel like I'm going{n}to get blown away!

entries.jp: {v:001B}北側の山から吹き下ろしている風だ。
entries.en: {v:001B}It's blowing down from the mountain to the north.

entries.jp: {v:001D}おい、どこへ行くんだ？{n}そっちはルートじゃないぞ。
entries.en: {v:001D}Hey, where are you going? That's not our route.

entries.jp: 何処へ行くと答えますか？
entries.en: Where will you say you're going?

entries.jp: ・間違い
entries.en: ・I went the wrong way

entries.jp: ・意味はない
entries.en: ・No particular reason

entries.jp: ・山へ行く
entries.en: ・To the mountain

entries.jp: {v:002B}ま、間違いは誰にでもあるからな。{n}さ、先を急ぐぞ。
entries.en: {v:002B}Well, everyone makes mistakes. Come on, let's hurry.

entries.jp: {v:001E}山に？{n}君たちは我々を護衛するために{n}ここにいるんじゃないのか？{p}{v:001F}どうして山に行かなくてはいかんのだ？
entries.en: {v:001E}To the mountain? Aren't you here to escort us?{p}{v:001F}Why do you need to go to the mountain?

entries.jp: なぜ山に向かうのですか？
entries.en: Why are you heading to the mountain?

entries.jp: ・敵と戦うため
entries.en: ・To fight the enemy

entries.jp: ・意味はない
entries.en: ・No particular reason

entries.jp: {v:0020}敵？{n}敵がいるというのか？
entries.en: {v:0020}The enemy? You're saying there's an enemy there?

entries.jp: {FB00}{v:0021}ああ、いるな。{n}あの山の上によ。
entries.en: {FB00}{v:0021}Yeah, there is. Up on that mountain.

entries.jp: {v:0022}どうしたの、ウォレスさんまで？
entries.en: {v:0022}What's gotten into you, Wallace-san? You too?

entries.jp: {v:0023}風に乗って流れてくるこの匂い‥‥。{p}{v:0024}といっても、普通の人間にわかる匂いじゃねぇが、{n}俺みたいに目の不自由な奴なら多少わかるんだ。{p}{v:0025}この匂いは以前嗅いだことがある‥‥。{n}モンスターを操る時に使う粉の匂いだ‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0023}This smell drifting on the wind...{p}{v:0024}An ordinary person wouldn't notice it, but someone who{n}can't see, like me, can pick up a little of it.{p}{v:0025}I've smelled it before... It's a powder used to{n}control monsters...

entries.jp: {v:0026}それじゃ、モンスターが暴れるっていうのは‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0026}Then all those monster attacks...

entries.jp: {v:0027}ローランディア軍を勝たせないようにするために、{n}誰かが操っているんだ。
entries.en: {v:0027}Someone's controlling them to keep the Rolandia army{n}from winning.

entries.jp: {v:0028}わかった。{n}君たちの言うことを信じよう。{p}{v:0029}しばらく様子を見て、{n}安全だとわかってから先へ進むようにする。{n}頼んだぞ。
entries.en: {v:0028}Understood. I'll take your word for it.{p}{v:0029}We'll wait a while and only move on once we know it's{n}safe. We're counting on you.

entries.jp: {v:002A}だったらこっちに戻ってくれ。{n}先を急がなければならないんだ。
entries.en: {v:002A}Then come back this way. We have to hurry.

entries.jp: おい。{n}俺たちは輸送隊の護衛中だぞ。{n}どこへ行く気だ？
entries.en: Hey. We're escorting the supply convoy. Where do you{n}think you're going?
